Command: Recite the Shema morning and evening
Summary: Deuteronomy 6:7 places the Shema in daily speech: 'thou shalt talk of them when thou sittest in thine house, and when thou walkest by the way, and when thou liest down, and when thou risest up.' Morning and evening recitation is the traditional shape of that daily talk.
Commandment: Recite the Shema morning and evening, and talk of God's words daily.
Application: Scripture's stated context: these words are to be in the heart first, and then taught diligently and talked of at home and on the road, morning and evening (Deuteronomy 6:6-7).
Purpose: Scripture's stated context: these words are to be in the heart first, and then taught — the command follows the confession of God's oneness (Deuteronomy 6:4-6).
